description: Scores an address on Tron, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base for address-poisoning look-alikes, dust and zero-value attacks, fake-USDT deposits and missing history. Pass "expected" to detect a look-alike of the address you meant to pay. Use before any outgoing USDT transfer. Costs $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum (x402).

address.description: Address you are about to pay or want to inspect (Tron T… or EVM 0x…, matching chain)

chain.description: Blockchain: tron, ethereum, bsc, polygon, arbitrum, base. Default tron

expected.description: Optional known-good address to compare against

name: tron_address_risk
